notes: Paired cold series measures 71aeb44; final preflight metadata optimization is measured in final-* cases. The final-profile-clean run includes CPU profiling and is not a cold median.
Cold means no existing index reused, not an OS-cache flush. Measurements run serially without local builds or tests.
process.cpu_ms comes from GetProcessTimes; per-worker *_cpu_total fields are historical elapsed-sum aliases, not CPU measurements.
Process IO is logical Windows process IO and includes SQLite, map reads and report output. FilesHashed/BytesHashed describe semantic scan jobs; map-manifest reads are additional.
